script.brief: See docs/video/scripts/ca03_trailer_script.md and docs/video/takes_ca03.md (recorded 23 Nov, commit 71fb068b1). Model ca07 and ca04 (attack-first). Marks and frame-time windows from the recorded takes; Sulafat VO; PeaceFolk Gently Decaying window from 104.478 s.
